actual.titulo: Devil in the Web • Scammed On
actual.descripcion: Scammed On | CeCe bonds with a man she meets on a dating app, and she happily obliges when he asks her for money for his business, but she becomes yet another victim of a romance scam.

siguiente.descripcion: Reptile Cult | Online cult leader Sherry Shriner reaches her followers through YouTube videos and keeps them in line via her Facebook page; when a group member dies in a tragic shooting, attention turns to Sherry and the control she wields over her followers.

lista.descripcion: Playing Doctor | Twenty-four-year-old Jessika Rovell falls for Jeffrey Marsalis' charm and good looks but when she discovers his secret online life as Dr. Jeff, she realizes she's been dating a monster who stalks dating sites.

lista.titulo: Web of Lies • Love You to Death
lista.descripcion: Love You to Death | Seventeen-year-old adoptee Chelsea Schobert feels out of place at home, then she finds acceptance with Shawn whom she meets online, but as their relationship develops, the whole family is drawn into a devastating series of events.

lista.titulo: Web of Lies • Crime Scene Selfie
lista.descripcion: Crime Scene Selfie | Twenty-three-year-old Amanda Taylor shares her entire life on the Internet, then a tragedy takes place, and her posts take a dark turn.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • The Springfield Three
lista.descripcion: The Springfield Three | On June 6, 1992, Suzie Streeter and Stacy McCall attend parties celebrating their high school graduation; by morning, the teenagers have gone missing, along with Suzie's mother, Sherrill Levitt; the case leads police on a nationwide search.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • Suburban Secrets
lista.descripcion: Suburban Secrets | After doting mother Cheryl Coker vanishes from Riverside, Ohio, numerous searches turn up nothing; as police take a closer look at the case, they uncover some disturbing information.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • Without a Trace
lista.descripcion: Without a Trace | In San Francisco, Kevin Collins, 10, disappears on his way home, galvanizing the residents to find him; with few leads to go on, Kevin's case sheds light on hundreds of other children who have vanished without a trace in the United States.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • Oklahoma Horror Story
lista.descripcion: Oklahoma Horror Story | Right before Thanksgiving, two masked gunmen reportedly invade a couple's home and kill the husband; with few leads, police use ballistics, forensics and neighborhood gossip to solve this cold-blooded murder.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • Nine Years in the Shadows
lista.descripcion: Nine Years in the Shadows | In 1988, a young woman is found murdered in her Modesto, Calif., home, leading police to investigate the strife and infidelity in her marriage; a surprising witness eventually comes forward.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • Law & Murder
lista.descripcion: Law & Murder | A double murder involving the family of a federal judge prompts an investigation of epic proportions by the FBI, U.S. Marshals and Chicago Police Department; at the end of the trail, law enforcement personnel learn the death count may climb higher.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates • The Truth About Blair
lista.descripcion: The Truth About Blair | Jennifer Brown, vanishes from her Limerick home and detectives race against the clock to find her. With her eight-year-old son asking where his mother is, investigators must confront a web of lies woven by the people she trusts the most.

lista.titulo: Mean Girl Murders • Running for Her Life
lista.descripcion: Running for Her Life | A West Philadelphia neighborhood is left reeling when a high school track star, who had her eyes set on Olympic glory, disappears without a trace.

lista.titulo: Hollywood Demons • Surviving 16 and Pregnant
lista.descripcion: Surviving 16 and Pregnant | Expecting teens met unexpected backlash after appearing on the controversial MTV show, "16 and Pregnant"; sixteen years since the show's debut, cast members open up about the struggles they faced in its wake, including homelessness, addiction, an FBI raid, and insinuations of murder.

lista.descripcion: On the Edge | Arkansas police stop a knifeman enraged over a midnight pot roast; in Delray Beach, Fla., officers must rescue two children teetering on a ledge with their mother who is high on drugs; in Utah, a trespasser attacks an officer with his own baton.
